title: Edna Croco — remembering Edna Maits and old Bethel
subtitle: Bethel Presbyterian Church, Historical Room — oral history: a research interview with Ann Connor
date_source: Stated on the tape, in the first eleven seconds: "This is Tuesday, September the 13th, 1983, and this is Ann Connor." (0:09, labelled ANN CONNOR). 13 September 1983 was a Tuesday, checked with date(1), so the reading is internally consistent. The source folder name carries no date at all, and nothing was inherited from a neighbour; the 2026-10-18 in the archive path is the digitisation date, not the recording date.

provenance.collection: Bethel Presbyterian Church — Historical Room oral histories
provenance.capture_notes: One continuous capture, ALAC 48 kHz stereo 16-bit, 2,059.776 s, 37,145,922 bytes, sha256 recomputed here. The source JSON records md5 4cae6a72735fa9ace86aa92f8cc16c1f. Measured on the master as received: mean -44.2 dBFS, peak -9.8 dBFS. Speech ends at 1,832.9 s (30:33); the remaining 226.9 s is silence, and the last 220 s from 1,840 s measures RMS -83.5 dBFS, peak -36.8 dBFS, i.e. no speech. A third of the file is runs of exact digital zero, the signature of a voice-actuated or squelch-gated recorder. A condensed listening copy, 'Edna Croco Interview (condensed).mp3' (1,648.11 s, mono 64 kbps, silent gaps cut), exists in the source folder; the transcripts point at the full-length master, never at that copy.

speakers.label: EDNA
speakers.name: Edna M. Croco
speakers.note: Of Bethel Park; 83 on the day of the recording. Born 20 September 1899 and died May 1988 per a genealogy index entry, which is a SECONDARY source — the primary obituary has not been obtained. The year is corroborated from the tape: she was 'about two years old' when the third meeting house lost part of its roof, and the 1951 history dates that storm to 30 March 1902.

speakers.label: ANN CONNOR
speakers.name: Ann Connor
speakers.note: Names herself on the tape at 0:09. She was building the Historical Room and narrates her errand into the recorder before the interview begins. Her turns were labelled INTERVIEWER in the first build and renamed on 2026-10-20; the label change altered no spoken word.
